origin.description: Create a progress bar for for-like loops when pboptions allow it.

arguments.name: min, max
arguments.text: Finite numeric extremes of the bar. Must have min < max.

origin.details: Uses getOption("pboptions") for type, style, width, char, initial, and min_time. Returns NULL when type is none or when type is shiny without a running Shiny app. Otherwise returns a progress bar object from timerProgressBar, txtProgressBar, winProgressBar, or tkProgressBar.
origin.value: A progress bar object, invisibly. NULL when progress is turned off.
origin.example:
opb <- pboptions(type="txt", style=1, char=">")
pb <- startpb(0, 10)
getpb(pb)
closepb(pb)
pboptions(opb)

translation.description: Start a progress bar when pboptions allow it.

arguments.name: min, max
arguments.text: Bar extremes. max must be greater than min.

translation.details: Reads the module pboptions dict. Returns None when type is none or shiny without a running app. replace_pboptions and reset_pboptions stand in for pboptions in checks.
translation.value: A progress bar object, or None when progress is off.
translation.example:
from pbapply.startpb import closepb, getpb, replace_pboptions, reset_pboptions, startpb

former = replace_pboptions(type="txt", style=1, char=">")
pb = startpb(0, 10)
print(getpb(pb))
closepb(pb)
reset_pboptions(former)
